rows.summary: **Now:** a hand cursor shows over every enabled button, link, summary, select, checkbox / radio / file / colour / range input, a label around a checkbox or radio, and clickable ARIA roles (a base rule in src/index.css); a control's own cursor class still wins, and a disabled one keeps the arrow. The test also requires a cursor class or a covered role on every onClick <div>, <span>, <li>, <tr>.

**Now:** the Bullet Optimizer, the Smart Cover Letter Generator and New Resume's starters close on a click beside the box, as every other modal does (useOverlayClose, the kit Dialog's rule). A click inside, text selected inside and released outside, or a drag begun outside and released inside, keeps the modal open.

**Now:** a new résumé starts from the account's own data: a look on New Resume's page makes a copy of the most recently edited résumé (or the one picked under "Your details from") on that look — its Personal Info, sections and design; never a letter; the source is never changed. With no résumé yet, a blank résumé on that look. A second click before the editor opens makes no second résumé.

**Now:** New Resume opens /new: the picker's looks (templates, designs, saved designs) with category chips, each a picture of the user's own résumé on it; a click opens the new résumé. Blank and the role starters stay below the looks.
